body: Ordered the M and it sits exactly like the size chart said it would. The quilting is thicker than I expected for the price and it hasn't lost shape after a month of daily wear over hoodies. Sage is more of a muted olive in person, which I actually prefer.
Zipper feels a little cheap, catches sometimes when I pull it up fast. Otherwise solid - warm enough for spring mornings and sage matches the photos.
Runs true to size, comfy over a sweater.

The quilting looks good and the stitching is neat, no complaints there. But I live somewhere cold and this is really more of a mild-weather piece than an actual winter vest - I still need a coat underneath once it drops below freezing. Fine for what it is, just don't expect heavy insulation.

Got this as a gift for my brother who's picky about outerwear and he's actually worn it every weekend since. The XL gave him room to layer a flannel underneath without looking bulky. Packaging was simple but the vest itself arrived in perfect condition.
Wait, it's sleeveless, oops. Shell fabric feels nicer than expected, sage is a bit darker than the photos. Would size up for a looser fit.

Wear this over a tee on cooler gym mornings and it doesn't restrict arm movement at all since there are no sleeves to worry about. Breathable enough that I don't overheat walking to the car after a workout. Shoulders sit right at true to size in the M, no bunching.

I ordered my usual L and the shoulder seams sit noticeably tight, almost restrictive when I reach forward. For a quilted vest that shouldn't happen since there's no sleeve to account for. Sent it back for a refund, wouldn't reorder without trying it on first.
Simple, warm-ish, goes with almost everything in my closet already. A little snug through the chest in S but nothing uncomfortable, just noted it.

Bought a hoodie from this store last year that held up really well after dozens of washes, so I trusted the brand enough to grab this vest too without overthinking it. Same story here overall - the sage colorway looks accurate against the listing photos, the quilting hasn't flattened out even after weekly wear since March, and the fit is consistent with their size chart the same way the hoodie was, which is honestly rare across different clothing categories from the same store. Only tiny note is one loose thread near the hem that I noticed after the first wash, I just snipped it off myself with scissors and it hasn't unraveled any further since. Would buy from them a third time at this point.

Honestly expected this to be more of a decorative layer than something functional, but I've worn it on a few chilly hikes and it holds heat better than I thought a sleeveless piece could. Zipper pull is a bit small for gloved hands, minor gripe. Sage color reads a touch more grey-green outdoors than in the listing photo.

The fabric feels thinner than the photos suggest and after washing once the quilting looks slightly flatter in a couple spots. Fit is fine, true to size in the XL, but for the price I expected the material to hold up a bit better right out of the gate.
Good vest, comfortable for the price 🙂

I order size M because usual my size in most stores, but this one come more big than I think, maybe cut is different from normal jacket in my country. Quality of the fabric is nice and stitching look clean, no problem there, this part I am satisfied. Just next time I will order S instead, I think that will fit closer to my body. Color also litle darker than picture but is fine still, not big problem for me since I wanted dark green anyway. My husband also try it on and he say shoulders feel comfortable, better than the jacket he bought before from different website. Overall is good vest, just pay attention to size before you order because chart maybe not so accurate for this item.

ordered this like 2 weeks before i actually needed it thank god bc shipping took way longer than the estimate, arrived almost a week late. vest itself tho, no complaints - sage is a good neutral color, fits true to size in L and layers fine over a flannel. just order early lol
